questions.q: What does it mean for an evaluation to have poor construct validity?
options: It runs too slowly to be useful in practice
It ends up measuring something other than the capability or behavior it claims to measure
It produces a score of exactly zero for every model
It was designed by more than one research team
questions.explain: A benchmark meant to test one property, like deceptive reasoning, can end up really testing a related but different property, like willingness to role-play a persona.

questions.q: What does it mean for a benchmark to be "saturated"?
options: The benchmark has been deleted from public repositories
Most tested models score near the maximum, so the benchmark can no longer meaningfully discriminate between them
The benchmark now requires more compute to run than before
All models score exactly zero on it
questions.explain: Saturation means the measurement tool has worn out, not that the underlying risk being measured has disappeared.

questions.q: Why is training-data contamination especially dangerous for safety-relevant evaluations?
options: It has no real effect on eval scores
It inflates scores through memorization rather than genuine capability, raising confidence exactly where the stakes of being wrong are highest
It only affects evaluations that use no held-out data at all
It always causes models to score lower than they actually should
questions.explain: If eval questions or close paraphrases leak into training data, a model can appear to pass through memorization, which is especially costly to get wrong on safety-relevant evals.

questions.q: How does Goodhart's law apply to safety evaluations specifically?
options: It doesn't apply to safety evaluations because they are immune to optimization pressure
Once a safety eval's pass rate becomes a tracked target that models get iterated against, a model can end up optimized for the eval's surface features rather than genuinely safer
It only applies to financial markets, not machine learning systems
It guarantees that any tracked metric will always improve the underlying property it measures
questions.explain: A measure that becomes a training target can be satisfied without the underlying goal being satisfied, letting the eval score and genuine safety quietly diverge.

questions.q: What is the main defense against eval contamination, according to this lesson?
options: Publishing every eval question as widely as possible
Held-out, unpublished eval sets that are periodically rotated — though no defense is perfect once an eval has existed publicly long enough
Running the eval only once and never again
Allowing the model being tested to help write the eval questions
questions.explain: Keeping eval items unpublished and rotating them periodically is the main practical defense, acknowledged in the lesson as imperfect rather than a complete fix.
